issues.description: In the UML in the problem statement the RollerCoaster class name is written inconsistently: line 26 declares "Rollercoaster" (lowercase 'c') while later relationship lines (39–40) and the tasks refer to "RollerCoaster" (camel-case). This naming/capitalization mismatch in the UML could confuse students about the exact class name they must implement.
issues.suggested_fix: Unify the class name in the UML to the intended spelling/casing. Change line 26 in the problem statement UML to "abstract class RollerCoaster <<abstract>> {" (camel-case) so it consistently matches the rest of the diagram, the task descriptions, and the solution.
